notes.title: Content Pack #1: Patch Notes for version 0.8.250501
notes.notes:
[h3]Ahoy, Sailors![/h3]
For May's patch we have our first content pack, which features a new weapon, new enemy, balance updates, and Steam Cloud Saves!

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
[b]Steam[/b]
[list]
[*] ✨[i][b]Added Steam Cloud Saves[/b][/i]
[*] ✨[i][b]New Achievement: Min-Maxer:[/b][/i] Max out a stat
[*] ✨[i][b]New Achievement: Purist:[/b][/i] Win a run with a single type of weapon
[*] Updated graphics for a few achievement
[/list][b]Weapons[/b]
[list]
[*] ✨[i][b]New Weapon: The Spinner.[/b][/i] A rotating Tech weapon that blocks enemy projectiles. Upgrades increase rotation speed and damage. Gain second Spinner when maxed
[*] Anchor: Multiple anchors now bounce off of each other. Increased base price from $22 to $23
[*] Steering now adds 1° for homing weapons seeking cones per Steering °/second
[*] Torpedo: base seeking angle: 160° (0 Steering)
[*] Flaregun: base seeking angle: 140° (0 Steering)
[*] Sniper: now unlocked by default
[/list][b]Enemies[/b]
[list]
[*] ✨[i][b]New Enemy: Seahorse.[/b][/i] A small fish-type wondering enemy that shoots slow-moving horizontal projectiles
[*] Kraken: Decreased head maximum health by 4%. Decreased projectiles rate by 50%
[*] Tentacle: Increased projectile speed from 3 to 3.25
[*] Increased the number of Fish spawned in wave 19
[*] Fixed an issue where enemy projectiles would sometimes behave inconsistently
[/list][b]Boats[/b]
[list]
[*] Jeboat: increased base Fixing from 1 to 2, Increased base Attack Rate from 0 to 1. Now unlocks the Flaregun upon defeating wave 10.
[*] Icebreaker: now unlocks The Spinner upon defeating wave 10
[*] Yacht: now unlocks the Rifle upon defeating wave 10
[/list][b]Crew[/b]
[list]
[*] Fisherman/Big Game Hunter: Reduced damage increase against Elites from +30% to +20%.
[*] Otter/Carnivore: Reduced damage increase against Fish, Squids and Crustaceans from +25% to +20%
[/list][b]Visuals[/b]
[list]
[*] New animation plays to show stat gained from random promotions
[*] Changed coral designs to better read as corals
[*] Updated Kraken ink puddle graphics
[*] Added a reticle snap animation when moving between targets
[*] Slightly modified the color palettes: Abyss, Sunset
[*] Modified ordering of various sprites in scene for more consistency
[*] Redesigned cargo pips for crew and weapons for better readability
[*] Slightly modified aim visuals: Harpoon, Torpedo, Cannon
[*] Updated Stat text and pips to be slightly lighter for better readability
[*] Fixed a minor typo at the end game screen

[/list][h2]Leave a review![/h2]
If you had a chance to play the game, leaving a review really makes a difference and will help us reach a larger audience.

[h2]Join the crew![/h2]

notes.title: Happy New Year! Demo update! 🎆
notes.notes:
[h2]Ahoy, Sailors, and Happy New Year! 🎉[/h2]
[h3]TLDR: Check out the new demo version of Nautical Survival![/h3]

2025 is here, and I’m thrilled to kick off the year with some exciting news for Nautical Survival! The demo has just been updated with brand-new content to keep your adventures fresh and thrilling.

[h2] What's New?[/h2]
[b]Meet the Otter 🦦[/b]
Joining us right from the alpha builds, the Otter is back and ready to join your crew! This adorable yet fierce mascot thrives in the darkest depths, bringing a unique high-risk, high-reward playstyle to your adventures.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44957232/31928cb386f015f58e4a7cb9cee3a885ce861837.png[/img]

[b]Introducing the Flaregun 🎆[/b]
What better way to celebrate the New Year than with a bang? The brand-new Flaregun is now available in the demo! This weapon features explosive homing projectiles, igniting enemies while adding a festive touch to your arsenal.

[b]UI and Balance Updates ✨[/b]
This version also brings a suite of UI updates to improve readability and provide a smoother experience. Additionally, visual upgrades and balance adjustments have been implemented to ensure that the seas feel even more immersive (especially check out the fancy new parallax effect).

[h2]Wishlist and Join the Crew![/h2]
If you haven’t already, check out the demo, give the game a wishlist, and hop into our Discord to share your feedback and connect with the community. Your insights are invaluable as I continue to shape Nautical Survival into the best game it can be.

notes.title: Quality of life update! 🦑
notes.notes:
[h2]Ahoy, Sailors![/h2]
We got some much needed quality of life features now available in the demo.

[b]New features:
[/b][list]
[*] [b]Tooltips[/b]: you may now hover over UI items to learn about them.
[*] [b]Unlocks Menu[/b]: shows all Boats, Crew, and Weapons available in the demo.
[/list][b] Updates:
[/b][list]
[*] [b]Deckhand[/b]: Handyman: fixing +0.6 hp/s. Ropemaster: steering +45°/s. Gunmate: attack damage +10%, attack rate +6%, attack range +15%.
[*][b] Pistol[/b]: levels 0-4: knockback 5. level 5: knockback 10.
[*] [b]Harpoon[/b]: cooldown 0.8s. levels 0-4: damage 12 > 18 > 24 > 30 > 36.
[*] [b]Level[/b]: The level is now surrounded by unpassable rocks.
[*] [b]Flag Races[/b]: Increased flag pointers size for better readability.
[*] Minor UI and sound fixes and improvements.
[/list]
We're slowly but surely progressing towards Early Access. I have a bunch of cool new stuff I'm excited to show, join us at the Nautical Survival [url=https://discord.gg/e2ujkXB4wF]Discord server[/url] to learn more!

Stay afloat,
[i]-Idan[/i]
